sources.excerpt: EarthQuaker Devices Info Email Search Menu EarthQuaker Devices Info Email Search Devices Dealers Blog About Studios OnomatoPedal Merch Faithful to the original in topology & tone but adds additional functionality for the modern player Park Fuzz Sound™ Vintage Germanium Fuzz Tone Park Amplifiers and EarthQuaker Devices have teamed up to bring you a faithful recreation of the original Park Fuzz Sound! While it retains the original sounds, there are several modern upgrades to improve performance, reduce extraneous background noise and add versatility: Metal film resistors and caps for quieter performance NOS matched germanium transistors for consistent, reliable tones Wider fuzz range, more than twice the original Smaller footprint, true bypass switching with LED indication and power supply compatible 1. Treble/Bass: This is the tone control, thicker tones to the right, brighter to the left. 2. Volume: This is the level control, louder to the right, quieter to the left. 3. Fuzz: This is the gain control, more fuzz to the right, less to the left. GUITAR SAMPLES Rock '70 Gibson Les Paul
